extracted.intended_audience: general audience interested in humor and personal development
extracted.subtask_description: A short web page summarizing a TEDx talk by Steve Rizzo that promotes the concept of an inner 'Humor Being' and argues that a sense of humor can empower people to overcome adversity. The page is promotional/ descriptive rather than a formal guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Humor Being (inner special power)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wouldn’t it be wonderful if you had a special power within you that could create miraculous happenings in your life? Well you do. It’s called your Humor Being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame humor as an internal resource or "special power" that can produce positive change in one’s life; present the concept as an empowering, personal tool rather than a mere joke-making skill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a sense of humor to empower attitude
rubrics_metrics.description: Laugh and Learn with Steve Rizzo as he shares inspiring stories on how a sense of humor can empower each of us with the attitude we need to overcome even seemingly insurmountable odds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate using storytelling and relatable examples to show how cultivating a sense of humor shifts mindset and builds resilience when facing difficult situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laughter as emotional fuel and repair
rubrics_metrics.description: "Laughter is the pit-stop in the rat race of life. It gives you enough emotional fuel and repairs to get back in the race."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portray laughter metaphorically as a restorative pause that replenishes emotional energy; suggest positioning humor as a practical coping mechanism that restores capacity to continue facing challenges.
